description: MCP server + CLI for HospitalLedger hospital price-transparency data
name: hospital-ledger-mcp

scripts.build: ../node_modules/.bin/esbuild src/server.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/server.js && ../node_modules/.bin/esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --outfile=dist/cli.js && printf '#!/usr/bin/env node\n' | cat - dist/server.js > dist/server.tmp && mv dist/server.tmp dist/server.js && printf '#!/usr/bin/env node\n' | cat - dist/cli.js > dist/cli.tmp && mv dist/cli.tmp dist/cli.js && chmod +x dist/server.js dist/cli.js
